The before log records the missing idle Use system setting radio outline.

gpu.scope: 16 actual-App light/dark desktop/compact GPU captures show Settings appearance radios, the checked staged text preference, canvas startup choices and the checked text-toolbar background preference. The exporter restores preferences and preserves document/history. Font counts are asynchronous snapshots.

checks: Strict workspace all-target Clippy, formatting, source-length and whitespace checks passed.
limits: The 3:1 test is a scoped UI boundary check, not a full accessibility certification or native screen-reader qualification. Complete Windows/historical fidelity, additional UI details and broader T15 acceptance remain incomplete. Prototype preferences remain explicit. No editing-engine, text-rasterizer or performance change.
